data.name: Water's Fury
data.description: You gain the ability to summon a rushing jet of water from the elemental plane of water and direct it against your foes. As a standard action, you can create a jet of water in a 60-foot line that deals %1d6 points of damage, and blinds the target that was struck for 1d6 rounds. A Reflex save (DC %2) reduces the damage by half and negates the blinding effect.|Sorcerer_MaridWatersFury_Dice|Sorcerer_MaridWatersFury_DC
